invariants.rationale: Methods returning metadata about a write operation are expected to provide a non-null result on completion.
The HoodieWriteMetadata object should always contain a non-null list of WriteStatus upon method exit.
getWriteStatuses should reliably return a List to conform to the method signature and downstream expectations.
Partition-to-write-stats mapping is important for write tracking and should be maintained.
Write statistics should be available at the exit of the write metadata computation.
